translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Tesalonicenses
book.title: Tesalónicagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Tesalonicenses

content: Jesús-danikoed-idu guagwar be gudi-samar
Gwenadgan, sana Bab-Jesús-danikoed-ibagan, degine, e-wachigandi an geg bemarga soged.
Ar bemar nue wismalad, Bab-Jesús-danikoed-e-ibagan ukiar nonikoed, igi atursamalad bemar wichuli ukiar mutik noni-dae, deyob Bab-Jesús nonikoed.

Ar dulemar sogdimaladgin: “Belagwapa neg-bogidik-itole, anmar nue bukwamar-itole.” A-ibagangine iba-buleddi ukiar nagunonikoed, igi ome-wargwen ukiar e-bonigan itoar-dae. Dulemar we-igargangi gwen wakinnosurmalad.
Gwenadgan, bemardi neg-sichidgi gwen gudisurmarsoggu, Bab-Jesús-danikoed-iba geg ukiar be imakmalad, igi atursaed ukiar ibmar-atursanoni daedyob.
Ar bemardi bela gwallu-meegwadginedid, degine, ibgined-mimmigan gumalad. Anmar neg-mutikid, degine, neg-sichidginedsurmalad.
Degisoggu, mer dulemar-baigangii anmar gabmarmogo. Suli, degisuli. Guagwar gudisamalo, nue neg-itoakwaa.
Dulemar-gabmalad mutik ise-gabar gabmalad. Mungumalad, mutik mungumalad.

Ar anmardi neg-ibgined-mimmigansoggu, nue neg-itoakwaa gudisamalo. Jesucristogi bensulidgi, degi, sabguedgi, anmar dukubukwa imakmarsun, igi Roma-sorda-wargwen na gwage-odukued nika e-binasgargi nasikdaedyob. Degine, bensulidgi Bab-anmar-abonoged edarbedii imakmarsun, igi Roma-sorda-wargwen na e-nono bendakega, bormo-gurgin na nonogi siedyob.
Ar Bab Dummad beedse anmar-odurdakega anmar-urbissulid. Anmar urbisad, adi anmar Dummad-Jesucristoba abonolegegar.
Jesucristo anmar-ular burgwisad, adi Jesucristo gannar danikir, anmar dula gudi-dibe, igi, burgwar-dibe, eba dula megnaegar.
A-ulale, na be muchub-muchub ogannomarsun, adi Bab-igargi bemar nasgumai-guegar, ar igi bato na be imakdimaladyob.
Pablo we-gardagi napi gwenadgan-unasad
Gwenadgan, nue-wilesakwaa bemar-abargi-arbadidimaladgi nue-binsaed-nikaa damalo. Bab-Jesús-igargi bemar-idudidid, degine, bemarga Bab-Jesús-nuggi be-unadimalad mag be dakee nanamaloed.
Ar Bab-Jesús-igargi-arbadiidba, bemar amargi nue-binsaed-nikaa, degine, nue-sabee dae-wilubmalad. Bogidik-itolegedgi na be gudii imakmarsun, mer na be urwemar.

Gwenadgan, anmar bese wilesakwaa egismarbar, dulemar-arbabisurmalad nue unao, adi arbamalagar, gwage-nollo-gudimalad-ogannogo, dule-burba-nollomalad be bendako, degine, binnalegwadgi bela dulemar-sedii be nanamaloed.

Gwenadgan, nue-be-dakoed, mer ibmar-iskana-imaksad-dulegi ibmar-iskana-imaked be imakoed. Suli, degisuli. Bur ibmar-nued na be muchub-muchub imakmar, degine, bela dulemar-baiganga ibmar-nuedbi be imakmarbarsun.
Weligwarbi itodigu be gumar.
Bali-bali gatik Bab Dummadse gordigu be gumar.
Ar ibmar-dargwen bega wis gusale, bela dog-nuedye Bab Dummadga be sogmar, ar weyob Cristo-Jesúsgi Bab Dummad abemaid.
Mer Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-bargaed sao. Suli, degisuli. Bur-gatik oarbaed be sae.
Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad bega Bab-Dummad-gaya-burbagi sunmakalir, mer baisur be dakoed.
Bela ibmar nue wilubdako, unnila igar-nueganbi be suoed.
Bela ibmar-iskana-galagwensur-daklemaladgi be bangu.

Bab-Dummad-sunnad, Bab Dummad ulubgi-bogidik-itogega dule-imakedi, bitigi bela bemar gwage-swilidik imakena-gadin. Be-sana, be-san-burba, degine, be-burba bela gutusuli bemarga imakena-gadin, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo danikidse.
Ar Jesús-anmarse-gochadi dule-yardakedsulid, anmarga-ibmar-saoye-sogsadi bela anmarga imakedsegad.
Gwenadgan, anmarga Bab Dummadse gormalo.
Bela gwenadgan na nue-angaagwaledgi, na be nued sogeye be sogmar.
Bab-Jesús-nuggi an bemarga sogmarsun, we-garda bela gwenadgan-Bab-Jesúsba-akananaimaladga absomalo.
Anmar Dummad-Jesucristo bela bitigi bemargi nued binsamalana-gadin. Be itomargua.
